name: mtrini-workspace
description: Mtrini Workspace — open-source AI development environment by Compiwer AI

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && pip install -r backend/requirements.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "python -m uvicorn mtrini.main:app --app-dir backend --reload --port 8787"
scripts.lint: ruff check backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
